Post everywhere.

Why It Matters

Manual vs Software

Manual / Excel

  • Same data typed again and again
  • Debits and credits can drift
  • Days to close the month

Accounting software

  • One entry, every report
  • Unbalanced journals rejected
  • Reports any time
40%less reporting time
Badge: Accurate Online case study at PT Jordan Beauty Products, up to 40%. Nilvia & Wijayanti (2024), Fair Value 7(2).
Two Models

Desktop vs Cloud

Desktop

  • Installed on your PC
  • One-time licence
  • Backups are your job

e.g. Accurate 5, Zahir Accounting 6

Cloud

  • Opens in any browser
  • Monthly subscription
  • Updates & tax changes automatic

e.g. Jurnal, Accurate Online, Zahir Online, Xero

Tax Connection

Software → Coretax

  1. Accounting software

    Records PPN & PPh

  2. PJAP optional

    Sends data host-to-host

  3. Coretax DJP

    e-Faktur, bupot & tax returns

Live since Jan 2025. Rules change, so check pajak.go.id.

Source: DJP, Pengumuman KT-06/2025 (pajak.go.id); klikpajak.id/blog/pjap-era-coretax.

Free trial of Jurnal or Accurate Online. Record October:

1Owner invests cashRp 50.000.000
2Grinder bought on creditRp 8.000.000
3Cash salesRp 12.000.000
4Pay grinder supplierRp 5.000.000
5Pay rent in cashRp 3.000.000
Print:Trial balanceProfit & lossBalance sheet
Check your answer

Net profit Rp 9 juta · Total assets Rp 62 juta · Payable Rp 3 juta

Recap

Key Takeaways

  • Same rules, faster work
  • Modules mirror business cycles
  • Jurnal, Accurate, Zahir lead locally
  • Software → PJAP → Coretax
